description: Prebuilt IRS/FTB reference corpus, tax year 2025: 170 documents (138 IRS, 32 FTB; 147 PDFs — form instructions, forms with their instructions and 52 IRS/FTB publications — and 23 FTB web pages), 23,003 passages, FTS5 + embeddinggemma-2 768-dim embeddings, Haiku contextual summaries, each document's source file (ref_document_files; ref_documents.format says pdf or html) and its publication date (ref_documents.published).
_notes: GitHub Release asset (corpus-v9 tag). Embeddings are EmbeddingGemma 2 (ollama/embeddinggemma-2, stamped in ref_meta), so clones running Ollama need no reembed. The source files live in the database, not in git; sources keeps their sidecars. corpus-v4 changed the schema (ref_documents.format, ref_document_files.source): replace an older corpus.db with `npm run corpus -- fetch --force`. Everyone downloads the full corpus; per-state packs are a future option if size demands it.
